description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Auton Soldier and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Auton Soldier dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Auton Soldier tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Burnt Offering, adding {B}{B}{B/R}{B/R}{B/R}{B/R}
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
